name: image-processing
description: Local still-image processing with Pillow — inspect, resize, convert, crop, rotate, compress, thumbnail, strip EXIF, and watermark images. Runs fully offline with no network or credentials.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: image.info
tools.description: Inspect an image: return its width, height, format, mode, and whether it carries EXIF metadata.

input.description: Path to the input image file

tools.name: image.resize
tools.description: Resize an image to the given width and/or height. Preserves aspect ratio by default.

output.description: Path to write the resized image (format inferred from extension)

keepAspect.description: Preserve aspect ratio, fitting within width/height (default true)

tools.name: image.convert
tools.description: Convert an image to another format (PNG, JPEG, or WebP). RGBA is flattened onto white for JPEG.

output.description: Path to write the converted image

format.description: Target format (default: inferred from the output file extension)

tools.name: image.crop
tools.description: Crop an image to the rectangle bounded by left, top, right, bottom (pixel coordinates).

output.description: Path to write the cropped image

tools.name: image.rotate
tools.description: Rotate an image clockwise by the given number of degrees. Expands the canvas to fit by default.

output.description: Path to write the rotated image

expand.description: Grow the canvas so no pixels are clipped (default true)

tools.name: image.compress
tools.description: Re-encode an image at a target quality to shrink its file size (lossy for JPEG/WebP).

output.description: Path to write the compressed image

tools.name: image.thumbnail
tools.description: Create a thumbnail that fits within a square box of the given size, preserving aspect ratio.

size.description: Maximum width/height of the thumbnail in pixels (default 256)

tools.name: image.strip_exif
tools.description: Save a copy of the image with all EXIF/metadata removed (useful for privacy).

output.description: Path to write the metadata-free image

tools.name: image.watermark
tools.description: Overlay semi-transparent text onto an image at a chosen corner or the center.

output.description: Path to write the watermarked image
